 DLC CAMPAIGN-5 UNDERWAY AT DC OFFICE DIMAPUR
 DC Dimapur, Dr. Tinojongshi Chang, NCS with other officials during the Nationwide Digital Life Certificate (DLC) Campaign-5 underway at DC’s Office, Dimapur on 9th November 2026. (DPRO Dimapur) 
 Photo News 
 November 09 2026 
 · Dimapur 
 The Nationwide Digital Life Certificate (DLC) Campaign-5 is underway at the Office of the Deputy Commissioner (DC), Dimapur, from November 1 to 30, 2026, under the theme “Empowering Pensioners Through Digital Services”.
 The campaign aims to facilitate pensioners in submitting their Digital Life Certificates (DLC) and accessing various pension-related services through digital platforms.
 Deputy Commissioner (DC), Dimapur, Dr. Tinojongshi Chang, NCS, stated that the initiative seeks to make the annual life certificate submission process seamless, paperless and hassle-free, particularly for elderly pensioners, while eliminating the need for them to visit banks or government offices for the process.
 The campaign is being organised in collaboration with the District Administration, Chief Medical Officer, Department of Treasuries and Accounts, Nagaland Pensioners Association, India Post Payments Bank, District Public Relations Officer and Lead District Manager.
 During the campaign, pensioners are being provided assistance with the submission of Digital Life Certificates, pension-related queries, free health camp services, and Aadhaar update and correction-related assistance.
 The campaign is being conducted on all working days from 10:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. at the Office of the Deputy Commissioner, Dimapur. Pensioners have been encouraged to avail themselves of the services during the campaign period.
 (Tovikali, IA, Dimapur)
